name: std::swap(std::shared_ptr)

declarations.code:
template <class T>

void swap(std::shared_ptr<T> &lhs, std::shared_ptr<T> &rhs) noexcept;

intro: Specializes the std::swap algorithm for std::shared_ptr. Swaps the contents of lhs and rhs. Calls lhs.swap(rhs).
